verdict.rationale: Sentry is a SaaS monitoring platform, so versioned APIs with a deprecation policy is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack does not document API versioning or a deprecation policy. The mentions of SDK version 11.0.0 and self-hosted date-based release versioning concern adjacent product versioning, not versioned APIs, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404s on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
